lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 医生，我肚子疼，不想吃饭。
lines.pinyin: Yīshēng, wǒ dùzi téng, bù xiǎng chīfàn.
lines.english: Doctor, my stomach hurts, I don't want to eat.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Téng duōjiǔ le? Yǒu méiyǒu fāshāo?
lines.english: How long has it hurt? Any fever?

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 两天了。没有发烧，就是不舒服。
lines.pinyin: Liǎng tiān le. Méiyǒu fāshāo, jiùshì bù shūfu.
lines.english: Two days. No fever, just feel unwell.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 我给你检查一下。躺下，别紧张。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gěi nǐ jiǎnchá yīxià. Tǎng xià, bié jǐnzhāng.
lines.english: Let me examine you. Lie down, don't be nervous.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 不严重，是胃炎。开点药，吃三天。
lines.pinyin: Bù yánzhòng, shì wèiyán. Kāi diǎn yào, chī sān tiān.
lines.english: Not serious, it's gastritis. Prescribing medicine, take for three days.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thanks doctor. How to take the medicine?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 饭后吃，一天三次，一次两片。多喝水。
lines.pinyin: Fàn hòu chī, yītiān sān cì, yī cì liǎng piàn. Duō hē shuǐ.
lines.english: After meals, three times a day, two tablets each time. Drink more water.
